extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The customer was interested in a plan that includes dental coverage, but no specific plan was discussed.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Owen! You effectively followed all the necessary steps and ensured the customer understood the disclaimer before discussing benefits. One area for improvement is to ensure the customer is aware of the specific plans that include dental coverage. You could say, 'Several plans do include dental, and I can highlight those for you now.'

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment, plan review in 4 days
